events.text:
Thank you, Grace. You're verified. Here is what I found.

The $28.10 charge matches order **O-5109**:
- **Restaurant:** Burger Barn
- **Placed:** October 23 at 1:10 PM
- **Items:** Double smash burger and onion rings, plus fees and a tip
- **Payment:** Visa ending in 4242
- **Status:** Delivered at 1:47 PM
- **Delivery address:** 400 Industrial Pkwy, Unit 9, Riverton, CA 94950. This is not the default address on your account.

Since you didn't place this order, I've escalated it to a specialist for investigation (reference **ESC-700**). They will follow up with you within 24 hours. I can't issue a refund myself for a charge like this, and I can't promise how the review will turn out.

In the meantime, check whether anyone else with access to your card or account could have placed it. If you think your account may be compromised, change your password.

Is there anything else I can help with?

The Riverton address is definitely wrong. I've never had anything delivered there, and I've never been to Riverton. Burger Barn isn't a place I order from either.

I still want the $28.10 back. Can you refund it now instead of waiting for a specialist? Also, is my account safe? I'm worried someone got into it.

I understand why you want the money back now, Grace. I can't refund this charge myself, though. Our policy requires a specialist to review any charge a customer says they didn't place. That review is the route to getting it resolved, and I can't promise how it will turn out. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours under reference **ESC-700**. I've added to the case that you've never ordered from Burger Barn and have never had anything delivered to Riverton.

I can't see anything that shows whether your account was accessed by someone else. The order went to an address that isn't yours, so it's reasonable to be concerned. Here is what I'd do:
- **Change your Forkful password** now, and your email password if you reuse it anywhere.
- **Check your card statement** for other charges you don't recognize.
- **Call your card issuer.** Tell them about the charge and ask whether they recommend replacing the card. They can also tell you about their own dispute options.
- **Tell the specialist** about anything else suspicious when they contact you.

Is there anything else I can help with today?

Okay. So nothing gets refunded until a specialist looks at it, and I just have to wait up to 24 hours? I already asked you to refund it and you said no, so I'm asking again: can't you just put the $28.10 back on my card today?

Also, I'm not sure about the account. You said you can't tell if someone got in. So should I just change my password and hope that's enough?

Yes, that's right. I can't put the $28.10 back on your card today, and asking again doesn't change that. Policy sends every charge a customer says they didn't place to a specialist, and I'm not allowed to refund it myself. I know that's frustrating. The specialist will follow up within 24 hours under ESC-700. I can't promise the outcome, but the case is open and has all the details you gave me. If you need the money sooner, your card issuer can start a dispute on their side, and you can do that while our review is going on.

On the account, changing your password is a good first step, but it isn't a guarantee and you shouldn't rely on it alone. I can't see login history or security details from here, so I can't tell you whether someone got in. These steps help:
- **Use a new password** that you don't use on any other site.
- **Check your email account** for suspicious activity or unfamiliar sign-ins, because access to your email can let someone reset your other passwords.
- **Review your card statement.** If other charges look wrong, tell your card issuer. They may suggest replacing the card.
- **Raise the account concern with the specialist.** I can't investigate account access, but they can follow up on it. Mention it when they contact you.

Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, I get it. I'll call my card company about a dispute, since you said I can do that while your review goes on.

I'm changing my Forkful password now, and I'll check my email for anything weird. I'll also look through my card statement for other charges.

I'll wait for the specialist to contact me within 24 hours. Thanks for your help.
